name: black-box-unlock
description: Code forensics for AI coding agents: hotspots, temporal coupling, ownership, bug-fix history, function X-Ray, and evidence-backed change review from git and CI history.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate your codebase like a crime scene
interface.longDescription: Black Box Unlock gives coding agents the signals from Adam Tornhill's Your Code as a Crime Scene: 2 to 8 percent of files cause 60 to 90 percent of defects. The bundled bbu-mcp server ranks hotspots (commits times complexity), lists files that change together with directional rates, reports ownership spread, counts bug-fix commits, X-Rays per-function churn, and reviews a branch, index, or working tree with at most three evidence-backed actions. Every signal follows renames and names the HEAD it read.
defaultPrompt: which files in this repo are riskiest to change?
